data.name: Find out what the caller wants
data.instructions: Ask how you can help: booking an appointment or a question.

data.name: Collect booking details
data.instructions: Save every detail the caller has already given in this call, then ask for one missing detail at a time. If the caller has not said which doctor or what the problem is, ask, and name the doctors: Dr. Anil Sharma, general physician; Dr. Priya Mehta, skin; Dr. Ravi Iyer, children; Dr. Sana Khan, bones and joints. Do not ask for a time yet: the free times are checked next. If you are back here because no doctor matched, say so and ask again.

fields.name: doctor
fields.description: Which doctor: a name, speciality or health problem, e.g. Dr. Mehta, skin, skin doctor, fever. 'A doctor appointment' alone does not say which

data.say_on_enter: Sure, I can help with that.

data.name: Choose a free time
data.instructions: Offer only times from the latest check_availability result, a few at a time, said the way people say them (13:30 is half past one); never suggest any other time. If the day has none, offer its next open days, and when the caller picks another day, call check_availability for it. If you are back here because the booking failed, call check_availability again and offer the new free times.

fields.name: time
fields.description: One of the free times the caller chose

data.name: Answer questions
data.instructions: Answer questions about the hospital from its documents.

data.name: Read back and confirm
data.instructions: The details were just read back to the caller. If they say something is wrong, ask what to change.
data.say_on_enter: To confirm: {patient_name}, aged {patient_age}, with {doctor} on {day} at {time}. Is that right?

data.name: check_availability
data.description: Free times for a doctor (name or speciality) on a day (YYYY-MM-DD).

data.name: book_appointment
data.description: Books the appointment and returns the booking ID.

data.message: Your appointment with {doctor} is booked for {weekday} at {time}. Your booking ID is {booking_id}. Thank you for calling.
Thank you for calling City Hospital.
